ee12c75e68.q: How should ecommerce founders use AI interviews to develop better project plans?
ee12c75e68.a: Instead of specifying exactly what you want AI to do step-by-step, start with an interview format where you give AI your general concept and let it ask clarifying questions one at a time. 3e2794797f.q: Why is asking AI one question at a time better than multiple-choice prompts?
3e2794797f.a: When AI asks multiple questions at once in a dialogue format, users often select 'other' and type out thoughtful responses, then the next question asks something already covered. Asking one question at a time lets AI adapt its next questions based on your specific answers, change its line of questioning when you provide new information, and avoid redundancy—for example, if you mention wanting a report sent to your assistant, it will reframe subsequent questions around that new requirement.
